name: Rina
source:
The Clumsy Cop

Rina's pure-hearted nature is one of her best qualities... but those around her often mistake it for weakness. Due to her timid nature, Rina's always drawing the short end of the stick, getting stuck with one unsolveable case after another, and it's starting to wear her down. Can you help her find her confidence and stand strong, or will you leave her to crumple under the weight of her insecurity?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.holmes]Google Play[/url]]
